name: Bodley, unseen on the balcony

date.label: Original World of Warcraft Classic · Dungeon Set 2 questline

summary: Near the entrance balcony of Blackrock Spire, Bodley appears only to one who can see ghosts. He had gone back toward the fortress and never returned. The quest giver fears he is dead; Bodley confirms it without ceremony and asks for help undoing the company’s wrong. If the top piece is already found, he can point toward the other two. His greeting is warm, even here, where the old danger began.
